Do not create any file: every task new_paths must be []. Write only data/candidates/morioka-city/review_candidate.json and tests/test_phase15_review_candidate_staging.py. Set package_state=prepared only when the candidate package is complete enough for human checking. Do not promote reviewed_complete or broaden beyond Morioka.
